verdict.rationale: Shopify's first-party docs describe Storefront MCP servers that connect AI assistants to real-time store commerce data. They also document UCP-based agent building for catalog search, carts and checkouts, plus dedicated Catalog, Cart MCP and Checkout MCP endpoints that let agents discover products and iterate on carts, so agents need not scrape. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that agents actually work against live merchant stores, and explicit detail on how a merchant's store exposes or enables its endpoint.
